insights.one_liner: University College Roosevelt is a small international liberal arts college in Middelburg with about 500 students; an IND sponsor that recently cut staff.

culture.text: Small-scale international liberal arts and sciences college founded in 2004 in the historic centre of Middelburg.
Around 500 students on a close-knit residential campus with an open curriculum of more than 150 courses.

open.text: Stichting University College Roosevelt is an IND recognised visa sponsor.
Its one current job here, an academic role in Middelburg, does not require Dutch.

growth.text: Laid off a quarter of its staff last year, according to AD.

worth_knowing.text: After last year's layoffs of a quarter of staff, three lecturers are refusing to leave.
